text:
alex: Heads-up: a bunch of late-ingest telemetry for EU region showed up for yesterday, causing the console recompute runner to spawn ~120 low-priority jobs. We need a short-term gate in console to avoid noisy replays. :sweat_smile:
nina: ugh. Is this from delayed S3 transfers or batching upstream?
alex: S3 arrival spikes + a retry storm from a client. Logs show ingestion timestamp skew ~2h.
derek: can we gate by event_received_time vs event_occurrence_time? we already store both.
maya: we do. But current reprocess UI only looks at the occurrence window and tacks anything outside onto the same job.
liam: proposing a "grace_window" toggle in console -- default 2h, override per-tenant. If late > grace, route to low-priority lane and don't auto-run unless manual approve.
alex: love that. also add a "preview sample" button to show sample of events that would be queued.
nina: +1. need to show estimated token cost and affected aggregates.
replay-bot: Started replay job 87451 (tenant=acme, window=2026-03-18T00:00Z..2026-03-18T06:00Z) :robot_face: 
derek: UX question: how to present canary so product teams don't flip it accidentally? Maybe a two-step modal and "dry-run" checkbox that returns sample rows without scheduling.
maya: backend: we can add parameter "route_policy=late_grace|manual|force" default late_grace. Scheduler will map late_grace->priority=low and quota_consume=false until approved.
alex: show config snippet:
```
POST /api/v1/reprocess
{
  "tenant_id":"acme",
  "start_ts":"2026-03-18T00:00Z",
  "end_ts":"2026-03-18T06:00Z",
  "grace_window_minutes":120,
  "route_policy":"late_grace",
  "preview":true
}
```
liam: nice. quota_consume=false for preview only. For late_grace if late fraction < 5% allow auto-run on dedicated capacity.
nina: what about telemetry dashboards? need an indicator per-tenant: late_event_rate, replay_queue_size, last_replay_time.
derek: add an alert when late_event_rate > 1% for > 30m.
maya: agree. also log decision reason into job metadata: "late_fraction", "grace_window_used", "route_policy".
alex: who wants to own front-end work? nina can design mock, liam picks backend API & scheduler change, maya handles job metadata and metrics. Derek will add alert rules.
nina: I'll mock the modal. rough copy: "Auto-run late events within X minutes: [2h v] [Preview] [Run now]". will add sample table.
liam: backend: I'll implement route_policy and add unit tests. will open PR w/ integration test.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for replayer-svc at 03:00 UTC.
alex: action items: PRs for API + scheduler + UI mock. runbook update to include grace policy and manual approve steps.
derek: also add a short runbook snippet:
```
If late_fraction > 5% -> Pause auto-run, ping #eng-platform, set temp grace to 4h, escalate to infra.
```
nina: estimate 2 sprints for end-to-end? UI + backend + alerts.
alex: ok let's aim first pass behind feature-flag in 1 week. :thumbsup:
liam: will create feature flag: feature/late-grace-routing
maya: cc @policy-team for tenant default values.
policy-team: noted. can we default EU tenants to 3h?
policy-team: we'll review defaults, send config doc.
alex: thanks everyone. I'll follow-up with a spec doc and attach sample query for the preview in the console.
